long_biography.plain_text:
Born in Frankfurt, Stephen Orenstein attended school in New Hampshire and studied at Lehigh University. After his father Alfred died in 1985, he left university to take over Supreme Group, the family business established to supply American military bases in Germany. Orenstein developed it into a global food, fuel and logistics contractor serving difficult operating environments.

The decisive expansion came through military supply work in Afghanistan, where Supreme became the principal provider of food and water to American forces and its revenue rose sharply. Forbes says Orenstein formerly held 75% of the company and still attributes his fortune to supply-chain services. His current portfolio includes commercial property across Europe and the United States and an investment in Eintracht Frankfurt, where he served on the supervisory board until 2024.
